newsitem.title: USA: Kodak Advantix cameras outsell traditionals.
newsitem.headline: Kodak Advantix cameras outsell traditionals.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said on Friday that its Advanced Photo System cameras outsold its traditional cameras in 1996.
Advanced cameras accounted for as much as 60 percent of point-and-shoot camera sales in major U.S. retail outlets in December, usually the biggest month for camera sales, it said.
Kodak has invested more than $500 million in developing its Advantix products.
For the year, more than four million Advanced Photo System cameras were sold worldwide from all manufacturers, with more than 50 models available.

The company said the huge installed base of 35 mm cameras -- 100 million in the U.S. alone -- will ensure strong sales of 35 mm film for the foreseeable future. But eventually, Kodak predicted, the Advanced Photo System will dominate consumer film sales.
